name: Scourge
description: Add a random negative affix with an Affinity of your choice, then min-equivalent-value positive affix
upgrade: +1 min point value to positive affix/1

name: Tweak
description: Reroll an affix of your choice
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/1

name: Enhance
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/2

name: Optimise
description: Add a random affix of the same Affinity as a random one of the highest-point affixes on the item.
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/2

name: Purify
description: Remove all lowest-point-value affixes from the item and replace them with a new random affix with a minimum point value equal to the points removed.
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/2

name: Negate
description: An affix of your choice has its point value multiplied by -1, then a new random affix is added with a minimum point value of the points lost.

name: Inspire
description: A dormant, unknown affix of an Affinity of your choice is added. It is revealed and activated the next time you complete a random mission, which is chosen now.
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/2

name: Refine
description: An affix of your choice is rerolled within its Affinity.
upgrade: +1 min point value to new affix/1
